           LAC VACCINUM DEFLORATUM

         Skimmed Milk

        (LAC DEFLORATUM)


A remedy for diseases with faulty nutrition; sick headaches, with profuse
        flow of urine   during   pain.   Car
        sickness  .



Head.--  Despondent. Pain begins in forehead to occiput, in
        morning on rising.   Intense throbbing  , with nausea,
        vomiting, blindness, and obstinate constipation; worse, noise, light, motion, during menses,
        with great prostration, and better by pressure and bandaging head tightly.



Stool.--    Constipation  .
        Stools hard, large, with great straining; painful, lacerating anus.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Colostrum
        (Diarrhœa in infants. Whole body smells sour. Colic).   Nat mur  .



Dose.--  Sixth, to thirtieth potency and higher.
